name: Jaipur (The Pink City)
tagline: Royal sandstone palaces, majestic hilltop forts, and rich vibrant bazaars
description: Founded in 1727 by Maharaja Sawai Jai Singh II, Jaipur is Rajasthan's royal jewel. Encased in terracotta pink walls, it boasts UNESCO World Heritage sites including the grand Amer Fort, the astronomical Jantar Mantar observatory, and the iconic honeycomb facade of Hawa Mahal.

howToReach.flight: Jaipur International Airport (JAI) at Sanganer, 12 km from city center. Direct flights from Delhi (50 min), Mumbai (1 hr 45 min), and Bengaluru.
howToReach.train: Jaipur Junction (JP). Top trains: Vande Bharat Express (Delhi to Jaipur in 3.5 hrs), Ajmer Shatabdi, and Ashram Express.
howToReach.road: Connected via Delhi-Jaipur Expressway (NE-4 / NH-48). Approximately 270 km from Delhi (4 hours drive) with modern rest stops.

plan.title: Royal Forts & Sunsets
plan.activities: Morning climb to Amer Fort, photo-stop at Jal Mahal water palace, sunset at Nahargarh Fort overlooking the illuminated Pink City.

plan.title: City Heart & Colorful Bazaars
plan.activities: Visit City Palace, Hawa Mahal, Jantar Mantar. Evening shopping for blue pottery and textiles at Johari Bazaar.

plan.title: Amer Citadel & Heritage Walk
plan.activities: Amer Fort, Jaigarh Fort (world's largest cannon Jaivana), Panna Meena Ka Kund stepwell.

plan.title: Old City Architectural Marvels
plan.activities: Hawa Mahal sunrise photography, City Palace royal museum, Albert Hall Museum night illumination.

plan.title: Cuisine & Cultural Village
plan.activities: Morning lassi at Lassiwala MI Road, visit Galta Ji (Monkey Temple), royal dinner at Chokhi Dhani ethnic resort.

plan.title: Craft Villages & Departure
plan.activities: Block printing workshop at Sanganer/Bagru villages, shop spices and silver jewels.

thingsToDo: Witness the sound & light show at Amer Fort under starry skies
Savor Dal Baati Churma, Pyaaz Kachori, and Ghewar sweet
Climb Nahargarh Fort for a 360-degree sunset over Jaipur
Hot air balloon ride soaring over Aravali mountain forts

name: Munnar & Alleppey Backwaters
tagline: God's Own Country: Emerald tea plantations, misty mountains, and tranquil houseboat waterways
bestTimeToVisit: September to May (Crisp cool hills & ideal cruising backwaters)
description: Perched 1,600 meters high in the Western Ghats, Munnar is draped in rolling green carpet tea plantations and shrouded in cool mountain mist. Combined with Alleppey's palm-fringed lagoons and traditional thatched houseboats (Kettuvallam), this is the quintessential Kerala experience.

howToReach.flight: Cochin International Airport (COK) is 110 km from Munnar (approx. 3.5 hrs scenic uphill drive through cascading waterfalls).
howToReach.train: Aluva (115 km) or Ernakulam Junction (ERS, 130 km). Frequent express trains connect from all Indian metropolitan cities.
howToReach.road: Connected by Kochi-Madurai Highway (NH-85). Smooth scenic roads passing Cheeyappara and Valara waterfalls.

plan.title: Tea Gardens & Echo Point
plan.activities: Visit KDHP Tea Museum, wander through Tata Tea Estates, evening photo session at Mattupetty Lake & Echo Point.

plan.title: Wild Nilgiri Tahr & Highest Peak
plan.activities: Early morning safari at Eravikulam National Park (Rajamalai), drive to Top Station for panoramic valley views.

plan.title: Scenic Ascent to Munnar
plan.activities: Drive from Kochi, stop at Cheeyappara Waterfalls, spice plantation walk in Adimali.

plan.title: Tea Heritage & Eravikulam
plan.activities: Eravikulam National Park, Kannan Devan Tea Museum tea tasting session, evening Kathakali & Kalaripayattu martial arts show.

plan.title: Descent to Alleppey Backwaters
plan.activities: Drive to Alleppey (Alappuzha), board luxury private thatched houseboat at 12 PM with traditional Karimeen fish lunch.

plan.title: Village Canals & Sunset
plan.activities: Shikara wooden canoe ride through narrow coconut canals, visit Marari white sand beach.

thingsToDo: Overnight houseboat stay in Alleppey backwaters with freshly cooked Malabar meals
Spot the endangered Nilgiri Tahr mountain goat in Eravikulam National Park
Pluck tea leaves and experience authentic tea tasting at KDHP factory
Watch Kathakali classical dance and Kalaripayattu ancient martial arts

name: Varanasi (Kashi / Banaras)
tagline: The eternal city of light, sacred river Ganga, and mesmerizing evening Maha Aarti
bestTimeToVisit: October to March (Crisp morning river breeze & festive season)
description: Considered the spiritual capital of India and one of the world's oldest continuously inhabited cities, Varanasi rests on the sacred banks of the Ganges. Pilgrims arrive from across the globe to bathe in the holy river, seek enlightenment, and behold the world-famous evening Ganga Aarti ceremony.

howToReach.flight: Lal Bahadur Shastri International Airport (VNS) at Babatpur (26 km from Ghats). Direct flights from Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, and Kolkata.
howToReach.train: Varanasi Junction (BSB) and Banaras Station (BSBS). Premier trains include Vande Bharat Express (Delhi to Varanasi in 8 hrs) and Rajdhani.
howToReach.road: Connected via Purvanchal Expressway and NH-19 (Grand Trunk Road). Smooth multi-lane road connection.

plan.title: Subah-e-Banaras & Ganga Aarti
plan.activities: 5:30 AM sunrise boat ride from Assi Ghat to Manikarnika, visit the golden Kashi Vishwanath Corridor, evening grand Maha Aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat.

plan.title: Alleys, Sarnath & Silk
plan.activities: Walking tour through ancient narrow galis, taste Banarasi Paan, Malaiyo & Kachori, afternoon excursion to Sarnath Buddha sanctuary.

plan.title: Sacred Ghats & Kashi Vishwanath
plan.activities: Morning boat ride along 84 historic stone ghats, Sugam Darshan at Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Banaras Hindu University (BHU) campus visit.

plan.title: Sarnath Buddhist Trail
plan.activities: Visit Dhamek Stupa where Buddha gave his first sermon, Sarnath Archaeological Museum (original Ashoka Pillar Lion Capital).

plan.title: Textile Weaving & Heritage Mansions
plan.activities: Visit Master Banarasi Silk weavers in Madanpura, evening classical sitar concert at historic music haveli.

plan.title: Forts & Riverfront Sunrise
plan.activities: Cross Ganga to 17th-century Ramnagar Fort, taste traditional Rabri and lassi at Blue Lassi shop.

thingsToDo: Take a sunrise wooden rowing boat ride witnessing bathing rituals and morning prayers
Behold the synchronized, mesmerizing brass lamp Maha Aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat
Walk through the narrow labyrinth alleys of Old Kashi discovering hidden temples
Savor street delicacies: Tamatar Chaat at Kashi Chaat Bhandar, hot Kachori-Jalebi, and Banarasi Paan

name: Ladakh, Pangong Tso & Nubra
tagline: The Land of High Passes: Shimmering sapphire lakes, ancient monasteries, and sand dunes
bestTimeToVisit: May to September (High mountain passes open & pleasant weather)
description: Known as 'Little Tibet', Ladakh sits 3,500 meters above sea level amidst the trans-Himalayan desert. It is celebrated for its crystal-clear color-changing lakes like Pangong Tso, dramatic mountain passes, whitewashed Tibetan monasteries, and the cold desert sand dunes of Hunder.

howToReach.flight: Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport (IXL) in Leh is one of the highest commercial airports in the world. Direct daily flights from Delhi (1 hr 15 min), Mumbai, and Srinagar.
howToReach.train: Nearest major railheads are Jammu Tawi (700 km) and Chandigarh. Major high-speed rail connectivity to Bilaspur-Manali-Leh is currently under construction.
howToReach.road: Two world-famous highway road trips: Manali-Leh Highway (428 km, open May-Oct) and Srinagar-Leh Highway (420 km, open May-Nov) passing breathtaking mountain passes.

plan.title: Acclimatization & Leh Bazaar
plan.activities: Mandatory rest for high altitude altitude acclimatization. Evening stroll to Leh Palace and Shanti Stupa for sunset.

plan.title: Indus Valley Monasteries
plan.activities: Visit Thiksey Monastery (resembling Potala Palace), Shey Palace, and Hemis Monastery.

plan.title: Pangong Tso Expedition
plan.activities: Cross Chang La pass (17,688 ft) to arrive at the mesmerizing turquoise waters of Pangong Tso.

plan.title: Acclimatization in Leh
plan.activities: Rest, hydrate, gentle walk around Leh Main Market.

plan.title: Hall of Fame & Magnetic Hill
plan.activities: Visit Magnetic Hill, Gurudwara Pathar Sahib, and the confluence of Indus and Zanskar rivers (Sangam).

plan.title: Nubra Valley via Khardung La
plan.activities: Drive across Khardung La pass (17,982 ft). Diskit Monastery colossal Maitreya Buddha statue and double-humped camel safari at Hunder sand dunes.

plan.title: Turtuk Balti Border Village
plan.activities: Visit the northernmost village of Turtuk on the LOC, explore apricot orchards and Balti stone heritage homes.

plan.title: Pangong Lake via Shyok Route
plan.activities: Scenic river road to Pangong Tso. Stargazing at the Milky Way under crystal-clear night skies in Spangmik.

plan.title: Return to Leh & Departure Prep
plan.activities: Sunrise lake photography, cross Chang La back to Leh. Shop Pashmina shawls and dried apricots.

thingsToDo: Camp under the dazzling Milky Way stars beside Pangong Tso lake
Ride double-humped Bactrian camels across the cold desert sand dunes of Hunder
Drive or bike across Khardung La pass, one of the highest motorable roads in the world
Attend the morning monastic chanting and butter lamp prayers at Thiksey Monastery

name: Goa (Sun, Sand & Portuguese Heritage)
tagline: Golden Arabian Sea shores, Portuguese baroque churches, spice farms, and vibrant coastal shacks
bestTimeToVisit: November to February (Sun-drenched days, cool evenings & celebrations)
description: India's beloved coastal paradise blends tropical beauty with over 450 years of Portuguese colonial history. From lively North Goa beaches and water sports to peaceful South Goa white sands, UNESCO churches of Old Goa, and lush spice plantations in Ponda.

howToReach.flight: Dabolim Airport (GOI) in South Goa and Manohar International Airport (MOPA) in North Goa. Direct flights from Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chennai, and overseas.
howToReach.train: Madgaon Junction (MAO) and Thivim (THVM). Top trains: Konkan Kanya Express, Tejas Express (Mumbai to Goa in 8.5 hrs), and Vande Bharat Express.
howToReach.road: Connected via NH-66 (Mumbai-Goa Highway) and NH-4A (from Bengaluru/Belagavi). Scenic Western Ghats road trip.

plan.title: North Goa Forts & Sunset Shacks
plan.activities: Morning visit to Aguada Fort & lighthouse, relax at Candolim/Anjuna beach, sunset cocktails at Thalassa Vagator.

plan.title: Old Goa & Latin Quarter

plan.title: North Beaches & Water Sports
plan.activities: Parasailing and jet skiing at Calangute/Baga, sunset stroll on Chapora Fort (Dil Chahta Hai point).

plan.title: Colonial History & Mandovi River
plan.activities: UNESCO churches of Old Goa, sunset cruise with live Goan folk dance on the Mandovi River.

plan.title: Spice Farms & Dudhsagar Waterfall
plan.activities: Day trip to the majestic 4-tiered Dudhsagar Waterfalls via jungle jeep safari and Sahakari Spice Farm lunch.

plan.title: Serene South Goa Escape
plan.activities: Pristine white sands of Palolem and Agonda beaches, kayak into Cola beach emerald lagoon.

Sunset dolphin spotting boat trip along Sinquerim and Morjim coastline

name: Agra & The Taj Mahal
tagline: The world's greatest monument of eternal love sculpted in pure white Makrana marble
bestTimeToVisit: October to March (Crisp sunrise mist & mild afternoons)
description: Commissioned in 1632 by Mughal emperor Shah Jahan to house the tomb of Mumtaz Mahal, the Taj Mahal is a universally acclaimed masterpiece. Adorned with delicate pietra dura gemstone inlays, symmetric Mughal gardens, and twin red sandstone mosques beside the Yamuna River.

howToReach.flight: Kheria Airport (AGR) in Agra, or Delhi's Indira Gandhi International Airport (DEL) 210 km away.
howToReach.train: Agra Cantt (AGC). Gatimaan Express (Delhi to Agra in 100 min), Taj Express, and Vande Bharat Express offer high-speed connectivity.
howToReach.road: Yamuna Expressway (6-lane modern toll road, 3 hours drive from Delhi) and Lucknow-Agra Expressway.

plan.title: Sunrise to Sunset Icons
plan.activities: Early morning 6:00 AM sunrise at the Taj Mahal, breakfast with Bedmi Puri, explore massive Agra Fort, afternoon sunset view from Mehtab Bagh across the river.

plan.title: Mughal Splendors

plan.title: Ghost Capital & Tomb of Akbar
plan.activities: Morning excursion to UNESCO Fatehpur Sikri (Buland Darwaza & Salim Chishti Dargah), visit Tomb of Akbar at Sikandra.

thingsToDo: Watch the Taj Mahal shift from pinkish-gold at sunrise to brilliant white at noon and silver at night
Explore the red sandstone palaces of Agra Fort where Shah Jahan spent his final years
Taste the world-famous sweet Agra Petha (Kesar, Paan & Angoori flavors) at Panchhi Petha
Visit Mehtab Bagh (Moonlight Garden) across the Yamuna for uninterrupted sunset photography

name: Rishikesh (Yoga Capital of the World)
tagline: Gateway to the Garhwal Himalayas, white-water river rafting, and serene meditation ashrams
bestTimeToVisit: September to November & March to May (Pleasant weather & ideal river rapids)
description: Nestled in the foothills of the Himalayas where the holy Ganga emerges from mountain gorges into the plains. Rishikesh is a global center for yoga, meditation, spiritual ashrams, and thrilling adventure sports like white-water rafting, bungee jumping, and riverside camping.

howToReach.flight: Jolly Grant Airport (DED) in Dehradun is just 20 km from Rishikesh (35 min taxi ride). Direct flights from Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, and Ahmedabad.
howToReach.train: Yog Nagari Rishikesh (YNRK) and Haridwar Railway Station (25 km). Vande Bharat Express and Shatabdi Express connect Delhi to Haridwar/Rishikesh in under 4 hours.
howToReach.road: Connected via Delhi-Meerut Expressway and NH-58. Around 230 km from Delhi (4.5 hours drive).

plan.title: White-Water Rapids & Evening Aarti
plan.activities: 16 km river rafting from Shivpuri to NIM Beach, cliff jumping, evening Ganga Aarti with brass lamps at Parmarth Niketan.

plan.title: Bridges & Beatles Ashram
plan.activities: Morning yoga session by the riverbank, walk across Lakshman Jhula and Ram Jhula, explore Chaurasi Kutia (The Beatles Ashram) graffiti domes.

plan.title: Riverside Ashrams & Cafes

plan.title: Adrenaline Sports

plan.title: Sunrise Temple & Waterfalls
plan.activities: Early morning drive to Kunjapuri Devi Temple (1,676m) for sunrise over Himalayan peaks, trek to Neer Garh waterfalls.

plan.title: Ayurveda & Sound Healing
plan.activities: Sound bowl meditation healing therapy and Ayurvedic massage before departure.

Experience sunset Maha Aarti at Parmarth Niketan with soulful kirtans and floating diyas
Visit the historic Beatles Ashram covered in vibrant spiritual murals and meditation stone caves
Hike to Kunjapuri Temple at dawn for views of snow-capped Himalayan summits: Chaukhamba and Swargarohini

name: Udaipur (The City of Lakes)
tagline: Venice of the East: Floating marble palaces, serene lakes, and Aravalli mountain sunsets
description: Known as the most romantic city in India, Udaipur is built around five sparkling artificial lakes: Lake Pichola, Fateh Sagar, Udai Sagar, Swaroop Sagar, and Doodh Talai. It is dominated by the colossal City Palace, the Lake Palace floating in mid-water, and ornate havelis.

howToReach.flight: Maharana Pratap Airport (UDR) in Dabok, 22 km from city center. Direct flights from Delhi, Mumbai, Jaipur, Bengaluru, and Hyderabad.
howToReach.train: Udaipur City Railway Station (UDZ). Connected by Chetak Express, Mewar Express, and daily superfast trains to all major hubs.
howToReach.road: Connected via NH-48 and NH-58. Excellent 4-lane highway connection from Ahmedabad (260 km, 4.5 hrs) and Jaipur (390 km).

plan.title: City Palace & Lake Pichola Cruise
plan.activities: Explore the sprawling courtyards and peacock mosaics of City Palace, sunset boat ride around Taj Lake Palace to Jag Mandir.

plan.title: Gardens, Havelis & Bagore Ki Haveli
plan.activities: Visit Saheliyon Ki Bari fountains, vintage car museum, evening Dharohar folk dance show at Bagore Ki Haveli on Gangaur Ghat.

plan.title: City Palace & Sunset Ghats
plan.activities: City Palace complex, Jagdish Temple, sunset rooftop dinner overlooking Lake Pichola lights.

plan.title: Monsoon Palace & Fateh Sagar
plan.activities: Drive up to Sajjangarh Monsoon Palace for panoramic Aravalli views, speed boat at Fateh Sagar Lake, visit Nehru Garden.

plan.title: Day Trip to Kumbhalgarh Fort
plan.activities: Excursion to UNESCO Kumbhalgarh Fort (world's second longest continuous wall after Great Wall of China) and Ranakpur Jain Temple.

plan.title: Artisan Markets & Farewell
plan.activities: Shop traditional miniature paintings, Mojari leather shoes, and silver handicrafts at Bada Bazaar.

Watch the colorful Dharohar Rajasthani puppet and folk dance show at historic Bagore Ki Haveli

Savor Laal Maas and Mewari Ker Sangri at an open-air rooftop terrace restaurant by the water

name: Meghalaya (Cherrapunji & Dawki)
tagline: The Abode of Clouds: Bio-engineered living root bridges, crystal rivers, and thunderous waterfalls
bestTimeToVisit: October to April (Crystal-clear Dawki water) & June-Sept (Monsoon roaring waterfalls)
description: Meghalaya ('Abode of Clouds') is a lush green paradise in Northeast India. Famous for the unique indigenous Khasi living root bridges bio-engineered over centuries from rubber tree roots, the crystal-clear glass-like Umngot River in Dawki, and Nohkalikai, India's tallest plunge waterfall.

howToReach.flight: Umroi Airport (SHL) in Shillong (30 km) or Lokpriya Gopinath Bordoloi International Airport (GAU) in Guwahati (120 km, 3 hrs scenic four-lane highway to Shillong).
howToReach.train: Guwahati Railway Station (GHY) is the major rail junction connecting all Indian states.
howToReach.road: Guwahati-Shillong Highway (NH-6) is a scenic 4-lane mountain road with picturesque pine forests and roadside Khasi tea huts.

plan.title: Guwahati to Shillong
plan.activities: Stop at majestic Umiam Lake (Barapani), explore Police Bazar, Don Bosco Museum, and sunset at Shillong Peak.

plan.title: Waterfalls of Sohra (Cherrapunji)

plan.title: Double Decker Root Bridge Trek

name: Hampi (Vijayanagara Empire Ruins)
tagline: The City of Boulders: 14th-century temple ruins, iconic stone chariot, and surreal boulder hills
bestTimeToVisit: October to March (Comfortable daytime winter weather)
description: A UNESCO World Heritage site that was once the prosperous capital of the Vijayanagara Empire in the 14th century. Spread across 4,100 hectares of otherworldly giant granite boulder landscapes, it features the iconic Vijaya Vittala Stone Chariot, musical pillars, and the sacred active Virupaksha Temple on the Tungabhadra River.

howToReach.flight: Jindal Vijayanagar Airport (VDY) in Toranagallu (40 km from Hampi) or Hubbali Airport (HBX, 140 km). Flights connect to Bengaluru and Hyderabad.
howToReach.train: Hosapete Junction (HPT) is just 13 km from Hampi. Direct overnight express trains run daily from Bengaluru (Hampi Express), Goa, and Hyderabad.
howToReach.road: Connected via NH-50 and NH-67. Smooth 4-lane highway from Bengaluru (340 km, approx. 6 hrs drive).

plan.title: Sacred Center & Royal Ruins
plan.activities: Virupaksha Temple morning blessing with temple elephant Lakshmi, climb Matanga Hill for 360° panorama, explore Lotus Mahal and Elephant Stables.

plan.title: Stone Chariot & Coracle Boat Ride
plan.activities: Vijaya Vittala Temple and the iconic Stone Chariot, musical pillars hall, circular coracle boat ride on Tungabhadra river at sunset.

plan.title: Classic Hampi Monuments
plan.activities: Vittala Temple, Stone Chariot, Queen's Bath, Hazara Rama Temple with Ramayana friezes.

plan.title: Anegundi & Monkey Temple
plan.activities: Cross river to Anegundi (mythological Kishkindha), climb 575 steps to Anjaneya Hill for epic sunset over boulder terrain.

plan.title: Bouldering & Sanapur Lake
plan.activities: Cliff jumping and cliffside cafe hopping around Sanapur Lake, explore prehistoric cave paintings.

plan.title: Hemakuta Sunrise & Farewell
plan.activities: Sunrise atop Hemakuta Hill overlooking Virupaksha gopuram, shop banana-fiber handicrafts.

thingsToDo: Admire the monumental 16th-century Stone Chariot carved from monolithic granite slabs
Take a traditional circular bamboo-and-tar coracle boat ride along the roaring Tungabhadra River
Climb Matanga Hill or Hemakuta Hill at sunrise for an unforgettable golden hour over ancient ruins
Explore the Royal Enclosure featuring the stepped tank (Pushkarani) and Queen's Bath

name: Kashmir (Srinagar & Gulmarg)
tagline: Paradise on Earth: Cedar pine forests, mirror-like Dal Lake shikaras, and world's highest cable car
bestTimeToVisit: March to May (Tulip gardens & green meadows) & Dec to Feb (Snow wonderland & skiing)
description: Famed through the centuries as 'Paradise on Earth', Kashmir mesmerizes with the floating lifestyle of Dal Lake in intricately carved cedar houseboats and colorful shikaras. Gulmarg ('Meadow of Flowers') boasts the world's second highest operating cable car and powder-snow ski slopes.

howToReach.flight: Sheikh ul-Alam International Airport (SXR) in Srinagar. Direct daily flights connect from Delhi (1 hr 20 min), Mumbai, Bengaluru, and Chandigarh.
howToReach.train: Udhampur / Jammu Tawi railway station, connected to Srinagar via the newly completed world's highest railway bridge over Chenab River on the USBRL line.
howToReach.road: Connected via Jammu-Srinagar National Highway (NH-44) through the historic Chenani-Nashri and Banihal Qazigund road tunnels.

plan.title: Dal Lake & Mughal Gardens
plan.activities: Shikara ride on Dal Lake passing floating lotus gardens, visit Shalimar Bagh and Nishat Bagh built by Emperor Jahangir.

plan.title: Gulmarg Alpine Gondola
plan.activities: Drive to Gulmarg, ride Phase 1 & Phase 2 Gondola to Apharwat Peak (14,400 ft) for snow skiing and views of Nanga Parbat.

plan.title: Old Srinagar Heritage & Crafts
plan.activities: Walk through Jamia Masjid, shop authentic Kashmiri saffron, walnuts, and hand-knotted silk carpets.

plan.title: Arrival & Houseboat Check-in
plan.activities: Check into luxury carved cedar houseboat on Nigeen Lake, evening sunset shikara ride.

plan.title: Gulmarg Mountain Adventure
plan.activities: Full-day snow excursion in Gulmarg, snowmobiling, and hot Kahwa tea in cozy pine chalets.

plan.title: Pahalgam Valley of Shepherds
plan.activities: Drive to Pahalgam passing purple saffron fields of Pampore and walnut groves along Lidder River.

plan.title: Betaab Valley & Aru Valley
plan.activities: Horse ride to Baisaran Meadow ('Mini Switzerland') and walk through dense pine forests of Betaab Valley.

plan.title: Sonamarg Meadow of Gold & Departure
plan.activities: Visit Thajiwas Glacier in Sonamarg with pony rides up to glacial ice tongues.

thingsToDo: Ride the world's second highest cable car (Gulmarg Gondola) reaching 14,400 feet at Apharwat Peak
Stay overnight in an authentic hand-carved cedar wooden houseboat on tranquil Nigeen Lake
Take an early morning Shikara ride to the floating vegetable market on Dal Lake
Sip authentic Kashmiri Kahwa tea infused with real saffron, crushed almonds, and cardamom

name: Andaman Islands (Havelock / Swaraj Dweep)
tagline: Pristine white sand beaches, vibrant coral reefs, and Asia's best Radhanagar Beach
bestTimeToVisit: October to May (Calm turquoise seas & prime scuba visibility)
description: An archipelago of emerald islands in the Bay of Bengal. Swaraj Dweep (Havelock) is world-renowned for Radhanagar Beach (Beach No. 7), consistently ranked among the top 10 most beautiful beaches on Earth with silky white sand, gentle turquoise surf, and dense tropical rainforest.

howToReach.flight: Veer Savarkar International Airport (IXZ) in Port Blair. Direct flights from Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai, and Bengaluru.
howToReach.train: Rail access via Chennai or Kolkata, followed by domestic flight or passenger cruise ship to Port Blair.
howToReach.road: High-speed private luxury catamarans (Makruzz, Green Ocean, Nautika) connect Port Blair to Havelock Island in 90 minutes.

plan.title: Catamaran to Havelock & Sunset
plan.activities: Speed boat transfer from Port Blair, check into beach resort, late afternoon sunset walk on Radhanagar Beach.

plan.title: Scuba Diving & Coral Safari
plan.activities: PADI introductory scuba diving session at Nemo Reef, afternoon sea-karting and water sports at Elephant Beach.

plan.title: Kalapathar Beach & Mangroves
plan.activities: Sunrise at Kalapathar Beach with black volcanic rocks, kayak through mangrove tunnels.

plan.title: Historic Cellular Jail
plan.activities: Arrive Port Blair, visit Cellular Jail National Memorial, evening Sound & Light show on Indian freedom struggle.

plan.title: Havelock Island Transfer
plan.activities: Makruzz ferry to Havelock, afternoon relaxation under mahua trees at Radhanagar Beach.

plan.title: Elephant Beach Coral Snorkel
plan.activities: Speed boat or jungle trek to Elephant Beach, glass-bottom boat tour and sea walking on the ocean floor.

plan.title: Neil Island (Shaheed Dweep)
plan.activities: Ferry to Neil Island, explore natural rock formation (Howrah Bridge) and sunset at Laxmanpur Beach.

plan.title: Ross Island (Netaji Subhash Dweep)
